The 2019 Asia Nanjing Regional Contest

A. A Hard Problem
int all_divisible(int N);
- Returns minimum K such that all subset of size K of [N] contains divisible elements.

B. Chessboard
int count_ways(int N, int M);
- Count the number of ways to walk through a N-by-M chessboard, with all prefix no gap.

C. Digital Path
int count_paths(int N, int M, int[][] A);
- Count the number of maximal paths, such that each subsequent step increase value by 1.

D. Holes
int[] expected_time(int N, int K, point[] H, point A);
- Given a N-by-N chessboard and K holes H.
- Start at A, find expected time to reach each hole.

E. Observation
int[] count_positions(int L, int R);
- Define f(d) be the number of (x, y, z) in Z^3 such that x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = d^2.
- Returns f(d) for each d in [L, R].

F. Paper Grading
void init(int N, string[] S);
- Given N strings as in S.
void swap_string(int X, int Y);
- Swap S[X] and S[Y].
int calc_score(string T, int K, int L, int R);
- Returns the number of substring in S[L..R] which has common prefix with T of length at least K.

G. Poker Game
int[] simulate_poker(int[] A);
- Simulate poker games between five players, and return the final pot.

H. Prince and Princess
optional(int) minimum_questions(int A, int B, int C);
- Given A persons always say truth, B persons always lie and C persons arbirary.
- Ask three kinds of queries: (1) Who are you, (2) Who in that room, (3) Which room princess stays.
- Find princess with minimum queries.

I. Space Station
int count_ways(int N, int[] A);
- Given N + 1 space stations each of A[i] energy, which you can only visit if you get at least that energy.
- Count the number of ways to visit each space station once.

J. Spy
int maximum_reputation(int N, int[] A, int[] P, int[] B, int[] C);
- Consider the matching (B[j], C[k]) that sums to A'.
- The reputation is defined to be sum of P[i] where A'[i] > A[i].
- Find the matching that maximises the reputation.

K. Triangle
point cut_half(point A, point B, point C, point D);
- Given triangle ABC where D on the border.
- Find the point that cuts ABC in half.
